issues.quote: revenue rising 19.6% to $716.9 billion from $638.0 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Going from $638.0B to $716.9B is about 12.4% growth, not 19.6%. Because of this the growth rate is overstated by roughly 7 percentage points.

data.summary: The analysis is not accurate: the revenue growth rate is wrong. Going from $638.0B to $716.9B is about 12.4% growth, not 19.6%. The other numbers hold up. The gross margin (50.3%) and operating margin (11.2%) match the figures given. Net income growth works out to about 31.3%, close to the stated 31.1%, which could be a rounding difference. The fiscal 2024 figures match what I know Amazon reported: revenue $638.0B, operating income $68.6B, net income $59.2B and diluted EPS $5.53. I couldn't check the fiscal 2025 figures against filings, so I only tested whether they add up. The point about operating leverage still stands with the corrected growth rate. Note that part of the net income jump may come from non-operating gains, not just operating leverage.
